'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Humanitarian aid during the Gaza war]] 
***[[May 2025 Gaza Freedom Flotilla incident|Gaza Freedom Flotilla incident]]
****A [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]-bound activist [[humanitarian aid]] ship, part of the [[June 2025 Gaza Freedom Flotilla|Gaza Freedom Flotilla]], catches fire and issues an [[SOS signal|SOS]] after what its organizers alleged was an [[Israel]]i [[drone warfare|drone attack]] off the coast of [[Malta]] in [[international waters]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/05/02/europe/gaza-flotilla-ship-sos-intl-hkn (CNN)]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least 43 [[Palestinians]] are killed, in the early hours of the morning by [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s on [[Gaza City]], [[Palestine]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/liveblog/2025/5/2/live-israel-kills-at-least-31-in-gaza-as-aid-blockade-starves-children (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Somali Civil War]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***The [[Rapid Support Forces]] capture the city of [[En Nahud]] in [[West Kordofan]] from the SAF, killing 19 and injuring 37. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/2/sudanese-paramilitaries-kill-19-after-taking-city-of-al-nahud-sources (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*''[[Rust (2024 film)|Rust]]'' is released theatrically in the [[United States]], three and a half years after a [[Rust shooting incident|fatal on-set shooting accident]] occurred involving members of the cast and crew, including cinematographer [[Halyna Hutchins]], director [[Joel Souza]], and lead actor [[Alec Baldwin]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/05/01/movies/alec-baldwin-rust-release.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[China–United States trade war]]
***The [[second Trump administration|Trump administration]] terminates the ''[[de minimis]]'' tariff exemption for some imports shipped directly to consumers. Online shops such as [[Shein]] and [[Temu]] [[purchase price adjustment|adjust prices]], while Temu also announces a shipping pause to the [[United States]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/05/02/business/economy/trump-china-tariffs-de-minimis.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy79j2n7d4o (BBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Eight people are killed after a car lost control and plunged into a ravine on the [[Karakoram Highway]] in [[Kohistan district]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2025/05/02/eight-of-same-killed-in-kohistan-car-plunge-3-dead-as-bus-overturns-in-karachi/ (Pakistan Today)]
*Seven people are killed in torrential rain across parts of [[Northern India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Delhi/7-dead-in-rain-related-incidents-across-north-india-roads-flooded-trees-uprooted-in-delhi-ncr/article69530654.ece (The Hindu)]
*Four people are killed and one critically injured in [[Dwarka]], [[India]], after a house collapsed due to heavy rain and thunderstorms. [https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/delhi/rain-thunderstorm-woman-children-killed-9978190/?ref=archive_pg (The Indian Express)]
*Three children, including two siblings, drowned in a pond in [[Nagarkurnool district]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/telangana/three-kids-drown-in-nagarkurnool-pond/article69529348.ece (The Hindu]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] reports 216 children have died this [[flu]] season in the [[United States]], making it the deadliest since the [[2009 swine flu pandemic]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/05/02/health/child-flu-deaths (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Immigration policy of the second Donald Trump administration]]
**The [[United States Department of Defense]] designates a second area on the [[Mexico–United States border]], attached to the [[Fort Bliss]] [[US Army|Army]] base in [[El Paso, Texas|El Paso]], [[Texas]], as a [[military zone]] to enforce immigration laws. [https://apnews.com/article/military-border-immigration-texas-mexico-d7d15f23bd755b95cd90cbb9a89df6fa (AP News)]
*[[Gang war in Haiti]], [[Haiti–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Department of State]] designates the [[Viv Ansanm]] coalition and the [[Gran Grif gang]] as [[Foreign Terrorist Organization]]s. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/state-department-labels-haitian-gangs-terrorists-rcna204475 (NBC News)]
*25-year-old Tyrone Thompson is sentenced to 22 years and six months imprisonment for murdering 21-year-old Mackenzie Anderson on 25 March 2022 in [[Newcastle, New South Wales]], [[Australia]], while he was on parole for a previous [[DV assault]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-05-02/domestic-violence-murderer-tyrone-thompson-sentenced/105237580 (ABC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Freedom of the press in the United States]]
**US President [[Donald Trump]] signs an executive order calling for the [[Corporation for Public Broadcasting]] to stop directly funding [[NPR]] and [[PBS]], and for government agencies to stop indirectly funding these public broadcasters. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/05/02/media/trump-cpb-pbs-npr-funding-cut-hnk-intl (CNN)]
*The [[Germany|German]] [[Constitution of Germany|Constitution]] [[Federal Office for the Protection of the Constitution|protection office]] designates the [[Alternative for Germany]] (AfD) party as a [[Far-right politics in Germany (1945–present)|right-wing extremist]] organization. The AfD came second in the [[2025 German federal election]] after winning 20.8% of the vote for a record 152 seats in the [[Bundestag]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy6zk9wkrdo (BBC News)]
